title: floc-consistency pipeline parameters
description: Consistency of floc clustering across batch sizes, checked against pairwise SNP distances

assemblies.description: Directory of assemblies (.fa, .fasta, .fna, optionally .gz). Sample names are file names without extensions.

outdir.description: Output directory (use a bucket path, e.g. s3://..., on Seqera Platform).

distance_matrix.description: Optional all-vs-all SNP distance matrix; when given, SKA2 is skipped. Long form (sample_a, sample_b, distance, e.g. a previous run's distances/ska_distances.tsv) or a square matrix with a header row of sample names. Tab-, comma- or space-separated, optionally gzipped. Sample names must match the assembly file names without extensions.

batch_sizes.description: Comma-separated batch sizes, e.g. '10,50'. Overrides start/step/stop. The all-samples reference run is always added.

start.description: Smallest batch size (when batch_sizes is not set).

step.description: Increase between batch sizes (when batch_sizes is not set).

stop.description: Largest batch size before the reference run (default: number of samples).

max_samples.description: Randomly select at most this many assemblies (seeded with seed) and use only them for every step. 0 uses every assembly.

shuffle.description: Shuffle the sample order (one order is used for every batch size).

floc_distance.description: floc --distance: Distance threshold used to create clusters (floc's own default is 0.03).

floc_ksize.description: floc --ksize: k-mer size. Unset = floc default (31 in floc 1.2.3).

floc_scaled.description: floc --scaled: Scaling factor for signatures. Unset = floc default (100 in floc 1.2.3).

floc_batch.description: floc --batch: Sequences floc clusters per internal batch (not the pipeline's --batch_sizes). Unset = floc default (1000 in floc 1.2.3).

floc_min_hash_freq.description: floc --min-hash-freq: QC: build the global hash from k-mers found in more than this fraction of all samples. Unset = floc default (0.05 in floc 1.2.3).

floc_min_hash_frac.description: floc --min-hash-frac: QC: a sample fails if less than this fraction of its k-mers are in the global hash built with --min-hash-freq. Unset = floc default (0.5 in floc 1.2.3).

floc_assign_metric.description: floc --assign-metric: Containment metric used to assign new samples to existing clusters: avg, min, max or query. Unset = floc default (avg in floc 1.2.3).

floc_assign_hash_freq.description: floc --assign-hash-freq: Assign new samples using cluster hashes built from k-mers present in at least this fraction of the cluster's samples; 0 keeps every hash (floc 1.2.1/1.2.2 behaviour). floc's own default is 0.5.

floc_dbscan_metric.description: floc --dbscan-metric: Containment metric used by DBSCAN; also used for --pairwise and --plot. Unset = floc default (avg in floc 1.2.3).

floc_ignore_qc.description: floc --ignore-qc: Remove samples that fail QC instead of failing.

floc_plot.description: floc --plot: Create PCoA and NJ tree plots (slow with many samples; plots are not kept).

floc_pairwise.description: floc --pairwise: Compute a pairwise distance matrix for each cluster with a new sample (not kept).

core.description: pairwise: SNPs in split k-mers shared by each pair; global: only split k-mers present in every sample.

snp_threshold.description: Pairs with fewer SNPs than this are flagged when floc places them in different clusters.
